title: 복습 F: 간판과 낱말, 실제로 읽기
objective: Read everyday words and signs aloud using linking, nasal change, a silent ㅎ, and tense sounds.
summary: Read real Korean words the way Koreans say them, using four sound rules.

task.title: Write the real sound
task.line: Read each word aloud, then write how it actually sounds inside [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: Let's meet in front of the school.

letters.as: Linking: a final consonant moves to the next vowel.
Final ㅂ before ㄴ or ㅁ sounds like ㅁ, and final ㄱ before ㄴ or ㅁ sounds like ㅇ (국물 [궁물]).
Final ㅎ before a vowel is silent.
After final ㄱ or ㅂ, ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ ㅅ ㅈ sound tense.

exercises: Linking: write the real sound. ① 단어 ② 직업 ③ 금요일
ㅂ or ㄱ before ㄴ/ㅁ: write the real sound. ① 입니다 ② 국물 ③ 작년
Silent ㅎ: write the real sound. ① 놓아요 ② 넣어요 ③ 좋은
Tense sound after ㄱ: write the real sound. ① 약국 ② 극장 ③ 숙제
